title: Mercy Brown vampire incident
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Mercy Brown vampire incident", at revision 1372029364, opens: "The Mercy Brown vampire incident occurred in Rhode Island in January 1892. It is one of the best documented cases of the exhumation of a corpse in order to perform rituals to banish an undead manifestation. The incident was part of the wider New England vampire panic." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q21214529, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "event in Rhode Island, US (1892)". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
